about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a brutal and beautiful universe where the fate of the galaxy is being decided in the depths of the asteroid belt. Take control of one of two unique warships, equip it with deadly weapons and set out to capture enemy bases in a fast and ruthless fight for survival.

Welcome to the world of interstellar warfare, where only your determination and skill will determine the outcome of the battle. Choose one of two spaceships, each with its own characteristics, and customize its armament - from lasers to homing missiles.

The objective is clear: destroy all enemies, capture key bases and prove that you are the best pilot in the galaxy. Tough battles, stylish visuals and hardcore difficulty make this game a real challenge for the bravest.

Game Features:

- Two unique ships with full customization of weapons

- Wide range of deadly lasers, cannons and missiles

- Battles in space

- Dynamic gameplay

- Stylized graphics

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 или AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
